text:
Ryan McLeod has four points in 16 games and was a healthy scratch against Columbus, a decision The Hockey News and Yahoo Sports both covered. In a Sabres video afterward his words were titled "Going To Take A Little Mental Reset Here And Find My Game." Lindy Ruff's message in another: "When He's Playing His Best, He Helps Our Hockey Team Win." The trade suggestions, including a reunion with Edmonton, followed.

Some of the slump is not his fault. Buffalo has scored 9.3 fewer goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice, the biggest gap in this group, and his 5v5 shot share is roughly even (49% of attempts, 50% of expected goals). That kind of on-ice shooting usually swings back.

Some of it is. He has only 14 shots and 1.76 expected goals, and he took a slashing penalty in his return against Tampa Bay. Evolving-Hockey also warned that last season's 1.9 wins above replacement ran well ahead of 0.6 expected. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him as a strong setup man who carries the puck in. That is the game Buffalo needs back.
headline: McLeod is in a hole, and the bounces dug part of it
